assessments.reasoning: The reacquired SAP keyword HTML matches the frozen digest and identifies itself as version 7.54. In ABAP Programs, lines 193–198 identify the structured type of an abstract CDS entity as usable after TYPE. The earlier description identifies the absence of a database object at line 179. Lines 199–202 expressly exclude using the entity as a data source for SELECT in ABAP SQL. These passages support the descriptive statement, its abstract-entity scope, and both stated limitations.

challenge.method: Checked whether TYPE usability referred to the structured type in ABAP programs and whether surrounding text constrained SQL use.
challenge.results: The ABAP Programs section explicitly permits the type use, while separate lines establish the absence of a database object and the ABAP SQL SELECT restriction.

limitations: The page documents an abstract CDS entity in SAP AS ABAP 7.54. The entity has no database object and ABAP SQL SELECT cannot use it as a data source.
